name: Indogulf Cropsciences Ltd
title: Indogulf Cropsciences Ltd - 544432 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Agrochemical maker grew FY26 revenue 19% to INR705 crore with PAT up 27%, but utilisation is only 52% and Q4 EBITDA margin fell to 13.5% from 16.5%, with no numeric FY27 guidance.

utilisation.quote: our overall capacity utilization improved to around 5 2%, reflecting improving operational efficiencies

capex.quote: Till date we have done around INR76 crores and additional will be around INR8 crores to INR10 crores.

triggers.label: Utilisation 44% → 52% (FY23–FY26)

triggers.label: Barwasni expansion adds 30–40% capacity
triggers.quote: the capacities we are almost increasing by 30% to 40% in that plant

triggers.label: Q2 FY27 price firming expected
triggers.quote: In Q2, we expect the price of our products to increase a little
